source: Live JSON-RPC probe against https://mcp.ainumbers.co/mcp (MCP-CONFORMANCE-AUDIT-1-2026-07-30.md, finding 1): the server's UnsupportedProtocolVersionError data.supported list tops out at 2025-11-25.
note: negotiated_protocol_version is the wire version the live compute worker currently speaks on the legacy initialize handshake - not a conformance claim. spec_edition_conformed is a SEPARATE statement: the estate's wire behaviour (-32022, -32020, -32602 codes, MCP Apps capability) has been brought in line with the FINAL 2026-07-28 specification text. These two facts must never be conflated in published copy. This file is the single source published surfaces read from; on a protocol bump, update this one file (re-verify via a live initialize/UnsupportedProtocolVersionError probe) rather than the pages themselves - scripts/verify-mcp-protocol-version.mjs fails the build if any published surface drifts from it.
